about_description:
This tool normalizes audio files using FFmpeg's loudnorm filter.
- Supports WAV, MP3, FLAC, AAC, OGG and more.
- Customizable LUFS and True Peak targets.
- Presets for common platforms like YouTube and Spotify.
- Log file for FFmpeg output.
- Options dialog for all settings.

WAV.description: WAV container with uncompressed audio: integer PCM or floating-point samples. Sample rate and bit depth are selectable.

MP3.description: MP3 defaults to 320 kbps CBR with LAME's highest algorithm-quality setting. Lower CBR rates and VBR quality modes are explicit choices under Quality / Bit Depth.

FLAC.description: Lossless audio compression with selectable sample rate and bit depth.

M4A.description: AAC in an M4A container defaults to a 320 kbps CBR target. Lower fixed-rate targets and quality-based VBR are explicit choices under Quality / Bit Depth.

OGG.description: Vorbis defaults to a 320 kbps ABR target. This encoder uses an average bitrate rather than strict CBR. Quality-based VBR is an explicit alternative under Quality / Bit Depth.

encoder_headroom_description: Additional headroom before MP3, M4A, or OGG encoding. Lowers the internal True Peak limit by the specified dB value; 0 dB disables this extra margin.
encoder_headroom_invalid: Encoder headroom must be a finite number between 0 and 3 dB.
results_encoder_headroom: Encoder headroom: {requested} dB requested, {applied} dB applied; pre-encoding True Peak limit: {limit} dBTP.
results_encoder_headroom_note: Headroom is limited by FFmpeg's minimum setting of -9 dBTP. Verification compares the encoded file with the selected targets.
output_encoder_headroom_help: Lossy encoding can raise signal peaks. Encoder headroom lowers the internal True Peak limit by the specified dB value before encoding, providing additional peak margin. The selected True Peak target remains unchanged. A value of 0 dB disables this margin.
mode_help_linear: Measures first and requests a fixed gain. FFmpeg can switch to dynamic processing if True Peak or loudness-range limits prevent linear processing.
mode_help_dynamic: Adjusts gain over time and limits peaks. This can reduce the difference between loud and quiet sections.
results_linear_fallback: FFmpeg used dynamic processing instead of the requested linear gain. This can happen when True Peak or loudness-range limits prevent linear processing. Dynamic processing can change dynamics.
results_mastering_dynamics: The mastering preset processes the audio before normalization and can change dynamics even when FFmpeg reports Linear.
layout_drag_hint: Drag the divider to resize the work areas. Window size and divider positions are saved automatically.
analysis_results_description: Original-file measurements from the latest analysis batch. Select a file to view its details and compare it with the targets selected when the analysis started.
analysis_read_only: Analysis only: the original audio files were not changed or encoded.
analysis_reference_note: Targets are a reference for the original file. A positive difference means above the selected target; a negative difference means below it. This is not a prediction or verification of normalized output.
analysis_unmeasurable_hint: Some measurements are unavailable, for example with silence or very short audio. Missing values are not treated as zero.
results_export_source_error: A report cannot overwrite an input or output audio file.
status_analysis_with_errors: Analysis finished. Some files could not be analyzed; see Analysis results.
analysis_results_tooltip: Shows loudness, True Peak, loudness range, PLR and target differences from the latest analysis.
normalization_results_tooltip: Shows status, targets and processing details from the latest normalization. "Verify output files" adds measurements of the finished output.
results_tooltip_empty: Run "{action}" first. Results become available afterward.
results_tooltip_busy: Processing is running. Available again when the task has finished.
